claims.claim: A beginner with no prior coding experience built a racing game using ChatGPT and the free Godot engine over two months of after-work sessions.
claims.episode_span: A guy who had never written a single line of code decided in August to build a racing game he could play on his MacBook.
claims.source_title: Asked ChatGPT, “Could We Make a Racing Game?” Now It’s His After-Work Hobby
claims.supporting_quote: It started in August with the idea of making a racing game to play on a MacBook. The developer had never written code or made a game before.

claims.supporting_quote: On our Engineering Blog, we offer 10 recommendations for how to design, run and report them.

claims.claim: Runway released its robotics model Praxis-1 with open weights and source code under the Apache 2.0 license; it leads the World Action Model category on Nvidia's RoboLab-120 benchmark.
claims.episode_span: Runway just released an open-source AI model called Praxis-1 that was trained on millions of videos and can now control robots. The model uses knowledge from video training for robot control and leads the World Action Model category on Nvidia’s RoboLab-120 benchmark.
claims.source_title: Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller
claims.supporting_quote: Runway releases its robotics model Praxis-1 with open weights and source code under the Apache 2.0 license. The model uses knowledge from video training for robot control and leads the World Action Model category on Nvidia's RoboLab-120 benchmark.

claims.claim: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Wallet on November 13, 2026, for ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US, allowing Dots AI agents to complete purchases after biometric approval with tokens from payment networks.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet on November 13, 2026, a feature that lets special AI agents inside ChatGPT actually complete purchases after you approve them with Face ID or a fingerprint.
claims.supporting_quote: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Wallet on Nov. 13, 2026, for ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US. The feature lets Dots AI agents complete purchases after biometric approval, while payment networks issue tokens instead of sharing card details.
